items.question: Which WNBA teams did Danielle Robinson play for?
items.answer: The San Antonio Silver Stars drafted Danielle Robinson sixth overall in 2011. She played for San Antonio (2011 to 2015), Phoenix (2017), Minnesota (2018 and 2019), Las Vegas (2020), Indiana (2021 and 2022) and Atlanta (2023). She was a three-time All-Star, led the league in assists in 2013 and made the All-WNBA Second Team in 2014.

items.question: What were Danielle Robinson's career averages?
items.answer: Danielle Robinson averaged 8.8 points, 4.1 assists and 2.8 rebounds in 359 WNBA regular-season games from 2011 to 2023.

items.question: Where did Danielle Robinson play college basketball?
items.answer: Danielle Robinson played four seasons at Oklahoma, from 2007 to 2011, before San Antonio drafted her sixth overall.

items.question: Is Danielle Robinson a basketball coach?
items.answer: After retiring as a player in January 2025, Danielle Robinson joined the Los Angeles Sparks as Manager of Basketball Integration and Scout Support and was promoted to assistant coach that April. For 2026, the Sparks listed her in the Manager of Basketball Integration role.
